title: Monic irreducibility over a polynomial ring and its fraction field
statement: Let $G$ be a field [def-weil-field], put $A=G[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and let $L$ be a field with an injective unital ring map $j:A\to L$ such that every element of $L$ is $j(a)/j(b)$ for some $a,b\in A$ with $b\ne0$; thus $L$ is a fraction field of $A$. For every monic polynomial $f\in A[X]$, meaning that its leading coefficient is $1$, let $f_L=\sum_i j(f_i)X^i\in L[X]$ be its coefficientwise image. Then $f$ is irreducible in $A[X]$ if and only if $f_L$ is irreducible in $L[X]$. In each ring, irreducible means nonzero and not a unit, with a unit factor in every factorization.
